title: F18 · imposter · Any Questions?
lines: Any second now, they will realise you do not belong here.
Everyone at this table went to a better college.
The senior director frowned at slide four.
On her desk that morning, her grandmother's tiny Shiva had fallen over. She had stood it back up.
A six-year-old once told a king: I am not here for you.
This number is wrong, he said.
It is right, she said. Here is where it comes from.
"It is right," she said. "Here is where it comes from."
You are not in the room by accident. Stand like it. That is sadhana.
